requirements.title: Applicant Domicile Validation
requirements.description: The system shall validate that the applicant is a domicile of Rajyapradesh during the registration process.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant is registering, When the domicile status is checked against the state database, Then the system shall display 'Valid Domicile' if the applicant's Aadhaar-linked address matches Rajyapradesh.

Given the applicant is registering, When the domicile status is checked against the state database, Then the system shall reject the registration and display 'Invalid Domicile' if the applicant's Aadhaar-linked address does not match Rajyapradesh.

requirements.title: Aadhaar-based e-KYC Verification
requirements.description: The system shall mandate Aadhaar-based e-KYC of the applicant to verify identity during registration.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant is registering, When the e-KYC process is initiated, Then the system shall prompt the applicant to enter their Aadhaar number.
Given the applicant has entered their Aadhaar number, When the OTP is verified, Then the system shall confirm successful e-KYC and enable application submission.

requirements.title: Mandatory Aadhaar Number Entry
requirements.description: The system shall require the applicant to provide their Aadhaar number as part of the registration details.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant is filling the registration form, When the Aadhaar number field is accessed, Then the system shall display a mandatory error if the field is left blank.
Given the applicant enters their Aadhaar number, When the format is validated, Then the system shall accept the input only if it is a 12-digit numeric value.

requirements.title: Mobile Number Verification
requirements.description: The system shall capture the applicant's mobile number to receive SMS notifications.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant is registering, When the mobile number field is accessed, Then the system shall display a mandatory error if the field is left blank.
Given the applicant enters their mobile number, When the format is validated, Then the system shall accept the input only if it is a 10-digit numeric value.

requirements.title: Category Selection
requirements.description: The system shall allow the applicant to select their category from the predefined options during registration.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant is filling the registration form, When the category field is accessed, Then the system shall display only the options: SC, ST, OBC, EWS.
Given the applicant selects a category, When the form is submitted, Then the system shall store the selected category without allowing any free-text input.

requirements.title: Annual Family Income Limit
requirements.description: The system shall enforce the maximum annual family income limit for eligibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant is filling the registration form, When the annual family income field is accessed, Then the system shall display a mandatory error if the value exceeds Rs. 3,00,000.
Given the applicant enters an annual family income, When the value is validated, Then the system shall accept the input only if it is less than or equal to Rs. 3,00,000.

requirements.title: Institution Name Entry
requirements.description: The system shall allow the applicant to enter the name of the institution where they are studying.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant is filling the registration form, When the institution name field is accessed, Then the system shall display a mandatory error if the field is left blank.
Given the applicant enters the institution name, When the form is submitted, Then the system shall store the entered institution name for verification.

requirements.title: Course and Study Year Entry
requirements.description: The system shall capture the course name and year of study for the applicant.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant is filling the registration form, When the course and year of study fields are accessed, Then the system shall display a mandatory error if either field is left blank.
Given the applicant selects the course and year of study, When the form is submitted, Then the system shall store the selected values for verification.

requirements.title: Bank Account and IFSC Entry
requirements.description: The system shall capture the applicant's bank account number and IFSC code for Direct Benefit Transfer.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant is filling the registration form, When the bank account number field is accessed, Then the system shall display a mandatory error if the field is left blank.
Given the applicant enters the IFSC code, When the format is validated, Then the system shall accept the input only if it is an 11-character alphanumeric code.

requirements.title: Renewal Attendance Percentage
requirements.description: The system shall capture the attendance percentage from the previous academic year for renewal applications.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant is applying for renewal, When the attendance in previous year field is accessed, Then the system shall display a mandatory error if the field is left blank or if the value is less than 75.
Given the applicant enters the attendance percentage, When the value is validated, Then the system shall accept the input only if it is 75 or above.

requirements.title: Declaration and Signature
requirements.description: The system shall capture the applicant's declaration and signature to confirm the authenticity of the information provided.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant is filling the registration form, When the declaration and signature fields are accessed, Then the system shall display a mandatory error if the fields are left blank.
Given the applicant enters their signature and date, When the form is submitted, Then the system shall record the declaration and signature as legally binding.

blocks.SOURCES:
[GO-1] (Info) The State Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme is presently administered through paper applications submitted at institutions and forwarded to District Social Welfare Offices. Applications take 6 to 9 months to be sanctioned, files are lost in transit, and students have no means of knowing the status of their application.
[GO-2] (Info) Government has decided that all applications under the scheme, fresh and renewal, shall be received, verified, sanctioned and paid online from the academic year 2026-27, so that eligible students receive the scholarship in a transparent and time-bound manner.
[GO-3.1] (Rule) The applicant shall be a domicile of Rajyapradesh.
[GO-3.3] (Rule) The applicant shall be studying in a post-matric course in an institution recognised by the competent authority in Rajyapradesh.
[GO-3.4] (Rule) For renewal, the applicant shall have attended at least 75% of classes in the previous academic year, as certified by the institution.
[GO-4.1] (Mandate) Applications shall be submitted online through the scholarship portal or through Common Service Centres (CSCs).
[GO-4.2] (Mandate) Aadhaar-based e-KYC of the applicant shall be mandatory.
[GO-4.3] (Mandate) Caste and income certificates shall be obtained from DigiLocker where available; otherwise the applicant shall upload the certificate in the prescribed format in Annexure A.
[GO-5.1] (Timeline) The nodal officer of the institution shall verify the application within 15 days of submission.
[GO-5.2] (Timeline) The District Social Welfare Officer shall sanction or reject the verified application within 15 days of receipt.
[GO-5.3] (Mandate) Reasons shall be recorded in writing for every rejection and communicated to the applicant.
[GO-6.1] (Mandate) The scholarship shall be paid through Direct Benefit Transfer using PFMS to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account of the applicant.
[GO-6.2] (Timeline) The scholarship shall be paid in a single instalment not later than 31 March of the academic year.
[GO-7.1] (Mandate) An online grievance facility shall be provided to applicants.
[GO-7.2] (Mandate) The applicant shall be informed by SMS at every stage of processing of the application.
[GO-7.3] (Timeline) Grievances shall be resolved within 7 working days of receipt.
[GO-8.1] (Mandate) A dashboard shall be provided to the District Social Welfare Officer showing district-wise status of applications.
[GO-8.2] (Mandate) A monthly report shall be submitted to the Principal Secretary, Social Welfare Department.
[GO-9] (Timeline) The scholarship shall be sanctioned within 30 working days of submission of a complete application, and the service is notified under the Rajyapradesh Right to Service Act.
[GO-10] (Mandate) Personal data collected under the scheme shall be used only for the purposes of the scheme.
[COR1-1] (Rule) In paragraph 3.2 of the G.O. read above, for "Rs. 2,50,000 (Rupees two lakh fifty thousand only)" read "Rs. 3,00,000 (Rupees three lakh only)". The annual family income limit for eligibility is accordingly Rs. 3,00,000 per annum.
[COR1-2] (Info) All other conditions of the G.O. remain unchanged.
[MIN-1] (Mandate) CSC operators shall be permitted to apply on behalf of students who do not have internet access, and the acknowledgement shall be sent to the student's mobile number.
[MIN-2] (Mandate) For renewal applications, documents already verified in the previous year shall be reused and shall not be uploaded again.
[MIN-3] (Mandate) The portal shall be available in Hindi and English.
[MIN-5] (Mandate) The portal shall work on low-end Android phones on 3G connections.
[VB-1] (Mandate) There should also be a mobile application for students, because most students have only a mobile phone.
[VB-2] (Mandate) The District Social Welfare Officer needs a dashboard showing the pending applications of every institution and how long they have been pending.
[VB-3] (Mandate) If an application is rejected, the student should be told the reason for rejection by SMS and be given one chance to correct it and apply again.

blocks.SUPERSEDED:
[GO-3.2] superseded by COR1-1: The annual income of the applicant's family from all sources shall not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 (Rupees two lakh fifty thousand only).
[MIN-4] superseded by GO-5.1: Institution verification shall be completed within 10 days of submission.
blocks.RESOLUTIONS:
[RES-1] Supersession GO-3.2, COR1-1: COR1-1 prevails.
[RES-2] Conflict GO-5.1, MIN-4: GO-5.1 prevails.
[RES-3] MissingReference GO-4.3: deferred to the department (open issue).
blocks.ANSWERS:
[ANS-1] When a DBT payment fails in PFMS (for example the account is not Aadhaar-seeded or is closed), what should happen to the application? Answer: Notify the student by SMS to correct bank details within 30 days; re-initiate in the next weekly batch
[ANS-2] Can a student appeal against rejection by the District Social Welfare Officer, and to whom? Answer: Appeal to the Director, Social Welfare within 30 days
blocks.ASSUMPTIONS:
[ASM-3] Legacy data migration: Only 2025-26 beneficiaries are migrated as a beneficiary master for renewal; pending paper applications are not migrated.
[ASM-4] Escalation on SLA breach: Institution delays are escalated to the District Social Welfare Officer, and DSWO delays to the Joint Director, Social Welfare.
[ASM-5] Renewal: The renewal window opens on 1 July and last year's beneficiaries receive a prefilled renewal application.
[ASM-6] Data retention: Applicant data is retained for 8 years after the last payment and then anonymised.
[ASM-7] Audit: All status changes, data edits and exports are logged, and the audit trail is viewable by the State administrator.
